reasoning_content:
Now memory is freed. Let me start dev servers one at a time sequentially, each in a persistent background process that I keep alive. I'll launch each with nohup and disown. Let me start with app.

Actually, since the local `just up` full flow requires dev servers started (foreground), and I ran --detach, the stack is verified up. The dev servers are the remaining piece. Let me start each individually in the background.

I need each process to persist. Use setsid/nohup.

action.command:
cd /workspace/app; nohup setsid pnpm nx serve app --configuration=instance --port=40461 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=app.urbo.localhost < /dev/null > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid=$!"; sleep 5; ps aux|grep 'nx serve app'|grep -v grep|wc -l

tool_call.name: terminal
